heading: Hours & Contact
text:
Meridian Home Comfort — Customer FAQ
## Hours & Contact
- Phone support: Monday–Friday 7:00am–7:00pm, Saturday 8:00am–4:00pm. Closed Sunday.
- After-hours emergency line: available 24/7 for no-heat, no-cool, and active water leaks. After-hours dispatch fee is $149 (in addition to repair cost).
- Service area: Austin metro — Round Rock, Cedar Park, Pflugerville, Georgetown, Leander, Hutto, Kyle, Buda, and Austin proper. We do not currently service San Marcos or Bastrop.

heading: Scheduling
text:
Meridian Home Comfort — Customer FAQ
## Scheduling
- Standard appointment windows are 8am–12pm, 12pm–4pm, and 1pm–5pm. A 4pm–7pm window is available Tuesday and Thursday only.
- You will receive a text the morning of your appointment with the technician's name and photo, and another text when the tech is 30 minutes away.
- Cancellations or reschedules more than 24 hours before the window are free. Inside 24 hours there is a $49 late-cancellation fee. No-shows (nobody home at the address) are charged the full diagnostic fee.

heading: Fees
text:
Meridian Home Comfort — Customer FAQ
## Fees
- Diagnostic fee: $89. Applied as credit toward the repair if you approve the repair during the same visit.
- Comfort Club members: diagnostic fee waived.
- After-hours / weekend emergency dispatch: $149.
- Trip fee outside the service area: not offered — we do not travel outside the service area.

heading: Payment
text:
Meridian Home Comfort — Customer FAQ
## Payment
- We accept Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Discover, and ACH.
- We do not accept checks or cash from technicians in the field.
- Card numbers are never taken over the phone. Agents send a secure payment link by text or email, valid for 24 hours.
- Financing is available on repairs over $1,000 and all system replacements through our financing partner. Approval takes about 5 minutes.

heading: Duplicate charges
text:
Meridian Home Comfort — Customer FAQ
## Duplicate charges
If you see two charges, one is usually a pending authorization that drops off in 3–5 business days. If both post, contact us and we will open a case with our payment processor.

heading: Before You Call: Quick Checks
text:
# Before You Call: Quick Checks

Many service calls can be avoided with these checks. Agents should walk customers through these before booking a non-emergency visit.

heading: AC not cooling or blowing warm air
text:
Before You Call: Quick Checks
## AC not cooling or blowing warm air
1. Confirm the thermostat is set to COOL and the set point is below room temperature.
2. Check the air filter. A clogged filter is the #1 cause of weak airflow. Replace if dirty.
3. Check the breaker panel. Reset any tripped breaker once. If it trips again, stop and book a visit.
4. Check the outdoor unit. If it is covered in debris or the fan is not spinning, book a visit.
5. If the indoor coil is iced over, turn the system OFF (fan ON) for 2 hours to thaw before the technician arrives.

heading: Furnace won't turn on
text:
Before You Call: Quick Checks
## Furnace won't turn on
1. Confirm the thermostat is set to HEAT and the set point is above room temperature.
2. Check that the furnace switch (looks like a light switch near the unit) is ON.
3. Check the breaker.
4. Check the filter.
5. If you smell gas at any point, stop immediately and follow the safety protocol.

heading: Thermostat screen is blank
text:
Before You Call: Quick Checks
## Thermostat screen is blank
1. Replace the batteries if it has them.
2. Check the breaker for the air handler.
3. Check the float switch in the condensate pan — a full drain pan will cut power to the thermostat on many systems. If there is standing water, book a drain line clearing.

heading: Water pooling at the indoor unit
text:
Before You Call: Quick Checks
## Water pooling at the indoor unit
This is almost always a clogged condensate drain line. Turn the system off to prevent overflow damage and book a visit. Do not pour bleach into the line unless instructed by a technician.

heading: Comfort Club Maintenance Plan
text:
# Comfort Club Maintenance Plan
_Effective: 2026-01-01_

The Comfort Club is Meridian's annual maintenance membership for residential HVAC systems.

heading: Plans
text:
Comfort Club Maintenance Plan
## Plans

### Comfort Club (Standard)
- Price: **$189 per year** per system, or **$16.99 per month**
- Each additional system on the same address: **$99 per year**
- Includes:
  - Two seasonal tune-ups per year (one cooling, one heating)
  - Priority scheduling — members are booked ahead of non-members
  - Diagnostic fee ($89) waived on all service calls
  - 15% off all repairs (parts and labor)
  - No after-hours dispatch fee on emergency calls
  - Annual reminder and filter-change notifications

### Comfort Club Plus
- Price: **$269 per year** per system
- Everything in Standard, plus:
  - Annual water heater flush and inspection
  - Annual whole-home plumbing inspection
  - 15% off plumbing repairs
  - $500 off any full system replacement (Standard members also receive this)

heading: Billing and renewal
text:
Comfort Club Maintenance Plan
## Billing and renewal
- Annual plans bill once on the enrollment date and auto-renew each year on the same date.
- Monthly plans bill on the enrollment day of each month and require a 12-month minimum commitment.
- Members receive a renewal reminder email 30 days before renewal.
- Existing members are locked at their enrollment price until their next renewal date, at which point the current price applies.

heading: Cancellation
text:
Comfort Club Maintenance Plan
## Cancellation
- Members may cancel auto-renewal at any time before the renewal date.
- Annual plans are non-refundable once a tune-up has been performed in the current term.
- If no tune-up has been performed, a prorated refund is available within the first 60 days.
- Monthly plans cancelled before the 12-month minimum are charged the remaining balance of the minimum term.

heading: Upgrades
text:
Comfort Club Maintenance Plan
## Upgrades
- Standard members may upgrade to Plus at any time. The difference ($80) is prorated for the months remaining in the current term.

heading: Transfer
text:
Comfort Club Maintenance Plan
## Transfer
- Memberships are tied to the service address and transfer to a new homeowner at the same address. They do not transfer to a new address.

heading: Repair warranty (Meridian labor warranty)
text:
Warranty Policy
## Repair warranty (Meridian labor warranty)
- All repairs performed by Meridian carry a **1-year labor warranty** on the specific part repaired or replaced.
- If the same part fails within 1 year, the return visit and labor are free. Parts are covered if they were supplied by Meridian.
- The repair warranty does not cover different components, pre-existing conditions noted on the original invoice, or failures caused by lack of maintenance, power surges, or customer modifications.

heading: New system installation warranty
text:
Warranty Policy
## New system installation warranty
- Meridian provides a **2-year labor warranty** on all full system installations.
- Comfort Club members at the time of installation receive an extended **5-year labor warranty**.
- Manufacturer parts warranties are separate and vary by brand (see table below). Meridian registers every installed unit with the manufacturer within 30 days of install. Registration is required for the full parts warranty term; unregistered units typically receive only 5 years.

heading: Manufacturer parts warranty (residential, when registered)
text:
Warranty Policy
## Manufacturer parts warranty (residential, when registered)

| Brand | Compressor | Parts | Heat exchanger |
|---|---|---|---|
| Trane | 10 years | 10 years | 20 years |
| Carrier | 10 years | 10 years | 20 years |
| Lennox | 10 years | 10 years | 20 years |
| Goodman | 10 years | 10 years | Lifetime (limited) |
| Rheem | 10 years | 10 years | 20 years |
| American Standard | 10 years | 10 years | 20 years |

Note: Manufacturer warranties cover the **part only**. Labor to replace a warranted part is billable after the Meridian labor warranty expires.

heading: Warranty transfer
text:
Warranty Policy
## Warranty transfer
- Manufacturer parts warranties may transfer once to a subsequent homeowner, usually within 90 days of the home sale and subject to a manufacturer transfer fee ($50–$100). Meridian can provide the transfer form.
- Meridian labor warranties do **not** transfer to a new homeowner.

heading: Filing a claim
text:
Warranty Policy
## Filing a claim
Call to schedule a warranty diagnostic. If the failure is covered, there is no diagnostic fee. If the technician determines the failure is not covered, the standard $89 diagnostic fee applies.
